description: The complete URL length is at least the total number of occurrences of all listed URL punctuation characters.
formula: length_url - nb_dots - nb_hyphens - nb_and - nb_eq - nb_underscore - nb_percent - nb_slash - nb_semicolumn >= 0
explanation: The counted character categories are distinct characters occurring in the complete URL, so their combined count cannot exceed the URL's character count.

description: The parsed hostname length does not exceed the complete URL length.
explanation: The hostname is a substring/component of the complete URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the longest raw URL-token length.
explanation: Every raw token is extracted from the complete URL, so no token can be longer than the containing URL string.

description: The complete URL length is at least the longest path-token length.
explanation: A path token is a substring of the complete URL; when no path token exists its recorded length is zero.

description: The hostname length is at least the longest host-token length.
explanation: Host tokens are components extracted from the hostname, and therefore cannot exceed the hostname's total character length.

description: The average raw URL-token length is at least the shortest raw-token length.
explanation: An arithmetic mean of nonempty token lengths cannot be below their minimum.

description: The longest raw URL-token length is at least the average raw-token length.
explanation: An arithmetic mean of token lengths cannot exceed their maximum.

description: The average host-token length is at least the shortest host-token length.
explanation: The host average is an arithmetic mean over the host-token lengths.

description: The longest host-token length is at least the average host-token length.
explanation: The host average cannot exceed the maximum host-token length.

description: The average path-token length is at least the shortest path-token length.
explanation: When path tokens exist this is the mean-versus-minimum property; when none exist the recorded shortest and average values are both zero.

description: The longest path-token length is at least the average path-token length.
explanation: When path tokens exist an average cannot exceed the maximum, and the no-token encoding sets both relevant extrema to zero.

description: The total extracted hyperlink/resource count is at least the external CSS-link count.
explanation: External CSS links are a subset of linked resources extracted from href and src attributes.

description: The complete URL length is at least the longest host-token length.
explanation: Host tokens are extracted from a hostname that is itself contained in the complete URL, so no host token can exceed the complete URL length.

description: The hostname length is at least the shortest host-token length.
explanation: The shortest host token is a nonempty component of the parsed hostname, and therefore cannot be longer than the hostname.

description: The hostname length is at least the shortest raw URL-token length.
explanation: The hostname contains nonempty host tokens, while the raw-token minimum cannot exceed the length of any host token; consequently it cannot exceed the hostname length.

description: The complete URL length is at least the shortest raw URL-token length.
explanation: Every raw URL token is extracted from the complete URL, so even the shortest nonempty token cannot be longer than the containing URL.

description: The complete URL length is at least the shortest path-token length.
explanation: A nonempty path token is a component of the complete URL, and the no-path encoding gives the shortest path length as zero.
